report.summary: The report is unusually well sourced: every tagged specific — the 44,28,000-share offer at ₹10 face value, the 1,130 lakh working-capital object, the FY2014-FY2018 revenue, net-profit, PBDIT, asset and borrowing series, the 52%/57% concentration figures, the ₹405.02 lakh unsecured loan, the 90.949% promoter stake carrying PAN AAMPM3121G, the March 2016 ROC strikes-off, and the ₹68.4/₹57.7/₹324.3 related-party amounts — matches the cited excerpts, including the unit conversions from lakhs to crore. No unsupported, contradicted or wrong-source tag was found, and the only un-tagged items are transparent arithmetic derived from already-cited figures plus one soft method note about the filing's 'trend notes'; blocking_count is zero.
